Reclaim space on the system drive withou: Reclaim space on the system drive without typing a single command. Every action is measured before anything is deleted.
The cleaner covers your temporary files,: The cleaner covers your temporary files, Windows temporary files, Prefetch data, Windows Update leftovers, Windows error reports, the Recycle Bin, the Windows Disk Cleanup profile and the component store (WinSxS). Project folders, documents and Downloads sit outside every audited root and can never be selected.
Windows blocks system folders for standa: Windows blocks system folders for standard users. When an action needs elevation the page offers a single restart button; the app reopens on the same page with your selection intact. The app itself still starts without administrator rights, so scanning and cleaning your own files never needs a prompt.
The interface only sends action identifi: The interface only sends action identifiers; paths are resolved and re-verified on the native side against a fixed audited list. Deletion never follows junctions or symbolic links, locked files are skipped and reported, and every run is written to the local audit history.
Nothing is uploaded. Sizes, logs and aud: Nothing is uploaded. Sizes, logs and audit records stay on this device.
A Windows scheduled task can run the qui: A Windows scheduled task can run the quick or standard profile daily or weekly. The task runs with the highest rights your account allows and asks nothing; remove the schedule from the same panel at any time. Prefetch, the Recycle Bin and the component store are never chosen automatically.
The same actions are available headlessl: The same actions are available headlessly for scripts and CI: dev-cleaner system --list, dev-cleaner system --clean quick --yes, or --dry-run to measure only.
